collection_scope: Independent award cohort; first source-acquisition pass
roster_count_rule: Only chronological Fields Medalist recipients; exclude Wiles1998 special silver plaque, include Perelman2006 with declined flag.
institutional_biography_note: Includes university-authored MacTutor historical biographies and recognized award organizations such as HLF. Institutional compilation is not an independent civil birth record.
claim_policy: Explicit printed components only; preserve day/month/year and calendar labels. Search snippets are discovery only. Single-source body support is not independent corroboration or formal Gregorian-DOB acceptance.
source_timing: Source access timestamps not recorded by the search tool remain null. checked_at_utc is the actual recording/completion time, not invented HTTP retrieval time.
stop_rule: End the bounded first pass with missing/partial records preserved. No automatic rerun, extra source mining or expansion to other awards.
analysis_scope: No hierarchy positioning or hypothesis testing; official award-age rule must be considered in a future separate analysis design.
age_rule: Candidate 40th birthday must not precede January1 of the award year; not simply under40 on ceremony day.
documentation_note: Protocol instructions and fixed roster preceded sharded targeted checks; this document is the after-collection record and is not labelled a preregistered statistical analysis.
